lines: I've made you cry, been cold to you, and still
if there's a feeling that draws us close, that's all I need
as far as I'm concerned, you're my last Lady
Ellie, my love so sweet
if we both wake and look at each other with cold eyes
and memories I can't tell anyone keep growing
when words fail us, love is over
Ellie, my love so sweet
smile more, baby, innocent, on my mind
shine more, baby, lovely, in your sight
the day of tempting tears falls
Ellie, my love so sweet
Ellie, my love so sweet
even if you slip away somewhere far off
I want to hold on to all you've given me
a little frustration suits you just fine
Ellie, my love so sweet
smile more, baby, innocent, on my mind
shine more, baby, lovely, in your sight
if this heart is sleet mixed with rain
Ellie, my love so sweet
Ellie, my love so sweet
smile more, baby, innocent, on my mind
shine more, baby, lovely, in your sight
after the tearful complaints are done
Ellie, my love so sweet
Ellie, my love so sweet
Ellie, my love
Ellie
